characters.name: Wrench (Ren Okafor)
characters.title: The Engineer
characters.role: The player. A Kestrel systems engineer who, three years ago, operated the Persephone sample arm. Everyone calls them 'Wrench'.
characters.appears: Entire game (first person; third person optional; in-engine scenes and cinematics)

story.want: Get the people in front of them to safety.
story.need: To accept responsibility for what they helped start without drowning in it.
story.wound: Raised by Ada after their mother died; Ada chose her career over them once before.
story.lie: "I just fix machines. The big decisions belong to someone else."
story.arc: Protect (Act I) → lead (Act II) → grieve and choose (Act III) → decide for a species (Act IV).

characters.voice: Three voice sets (A/B/C), each recorded opposite the same Ada. Warm, dry, practical; humor under pressure.

visual.silhouette: Practical, compact and grounded: tool belt, rolled sleeves, wrist pad. Reads as 'the one who fixes things' at 30 m.
visual.face: Default preset: warm brown skin, strong brows, tired but kind eyes, a small scar through the left eyebrow (a welding accident, so it's always there regardless of preset).
visual.hair: Default: short twists under a Kestrel cap. 36 styles in the creator.
visual.body: 1.78 m default; 1.55–1.95 m range; four builds.
visual.marks: Burn scar on the right forearm (optional), green bite scars accumulate from infection events (story-driven decals).
visual.acting: Always doing something with their hands. Rarely still. Tired shoulders, quick eyes.
